functions.description: The permissioned allows owner of the permission to record core contract addresses for a given branch in the BOLDToken contract. It is used once, purely for contract initialization upon deployment.

The permission allows owner of the permission to record the CollateralRegistry core contract address in the BOLDToken contract. It is used once, purely for contract initialization upon deployment, and it renounces ownership after recording the address.
